subtraditions.name: Theravada Buddhism
subtraditions.description: Traditions especially prominent in Sri Lanka and Southeast Asia, with Pali liturgical use and distinctive commentarial inheritance. Communities within this stream differ.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Mahayana Buddhism
subtraditions.description: A diverse Buddhist stream encompassing schools across Central and East Asia. The cited overview includes Pure Land and Zen and treats Vajrayana as part of Mahayana.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Vajrayana Buddhism
subtraditions.description: An esoteric Buddhist stream that developed within Mahayana. Its prominence in Tibet does not make it exclusive to Tibet; the source also notes forms in China and Japan.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Pure Land traditions
subtraditions.description: A family of Mahayana schools identified in the cited overview. Individual communities, languages and practices require their own records.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Zen traditions
subtraditions.description: A family of Mahayana schools identified in the cited overview. This umbrella entry does not equate all regional lineages or replace their own names.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Vaishnava traditions
subtraditions.description: One of the devotional streams identified in the cited Hinduism overview. Devotional streams coexist with philosophical traditions and are not an exhaustive classification of Hindu practice.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Shaiva traditions
subtraditions.description: A devotional stream within the diverse Hindu traditions described by the source. This entry does not imply one uniform institution, canon or community.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Shakta traditions
subtraditions.description: A devotional stream identified alongside Vaishnava and Shaiva traditions. A broad stream label does not supply a community-specific canon or complete history.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Sunni traditions
subtraditions.description: An Islamic tradition whose historical differentiation from Shi’i communities involves questions of leadership and authority. Specific legal schools and communities require further classification.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Shi’i traditions
subtraditions.description: An Islamic tradition distinguished in the source through debates over leadership and authority. The label contains further diversity; it is not a single legal school or institution.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Sufi movements
subtraditions.description: Devotional and mystical movements that cross divisions within Islam. This relationship is not an assertion of a mutually exclusive third denomination beside Sunni and Shi’i traditions.
subtraditions.reviewStatus: Source-checked introductory metadata; community-level review incomplete

subtraditions.name: Catholic traditions
subtraditions.description: One broad Christian stream in the cited overview. The three-stream outline is introductory and does not exhaust Christian diversity or settle theological claims.

subtraditions.name: Orthodox Christian churches
subtraditions.description: A broad family label used by the cited overview. Particular churches require separate records and must not be treated as a single institution.

subtraditions.name: Protestant movements
subtraditions.description: A diverse Christian stream in the cited overview, containing many churches and movements. The source warns that broad categories cannot capture the full range of Christian communities.
